decision.scope: The Kani verification lane's equation-family resolution under catherine-6g2: the compose resolution walk — CompiledEquation paths as bounded tables (Bounded<Step, ARROWS_CAP>; array-backed under cfg(kani), Vec-backed and arbitrary-sized in production) plus the concrete-bound, non-?-chained walk in engine_compose and the soundness half's independent compose — measured under the 8 GB / 300 s standard.
decision.rationale: The lane extends: 0006's recorded compose-side trigger was executed and the equation-family symex wall is cleared. The pre-change tree reproduces the recorded wall (both check_equation_panic_freedom and soundness_equation time out at the 300 s wall inside symex, the trace in memcmp churn and the old slice-path compose loop unrolling to the unwind cap); the post-change tree completes symex — 48.1 s (946 448 steps, 46 245 VCCs, 9 692 after slicing) and 59.0 s (1 211 749 steps, 70 835 VCCs, 19 897 after slicing) — and both harnesses die at the 8 GB scope budget during the propositional reduction (scope TERM, rc 143; ~6.0 GB peak recorded for the check harness). The walk's partition and emission order are unchanged; the bounded paths carry no heap pointers into the symbolic equation select. Remaining, measured: the 0004-class reduction wall at ~10-20 k post-slicing VCCs (solver tuning retired, budget closed per 0004); the recorded next lever is per-property partitioning of the equation-family harnesses (Decision 4's build precedent) or a further formula-mass reduction on the family walk. The other eight undetermined harnesses were not re-run this round and keep their 2026-11-23 attributions. Two lane repairs landed with the round: the budget classifier recognizes the scope-level systemd TERM (rc 143) that precedes the cgroup SIGKILL (rc 137) — a MemoryMax breach is undetermined, never a harness error; and the round-2 commit's cfg(kani) compile breakage is repaired (a lost as u64 cast in soundness.rs — the 2026-11-23 recorded runs were made on uncommitted tree state the commit did not capture), so the committed lane is compilable again. Contract suite (132 suites, 633 tests), clippy -D warnings, fmt, and ledger-check all green; the four proved build harnesses are untouched.
holes_found: no walker-family harness is a completed proof at the standard yet; both equation-family harnesses now reach the propositional reduction with bounded formulas and die at the 8 GB scope budget (rc 143) — the 0004-class reduction wall, not symex

the recorded next lever: per-property partitioning of the equation-family harnesses (Decision 4's build precedent) or a further formula-mass reduction on the family walk — recorded, not funded; the eight other undetermined harnesses keep their 2026-11-23 attributions unmeasured under the new walk
decision.fixture_only_comparison: The fixture corpus and the contract suite pin the parsed surface byte-identically — the bounded paths are Vec-backed and arbitrary-sized off the lane, and the walk's partition and emission order are unchanged. Cost: two 300 s baseline timeout runs (pre-change tree) and two post-change budget-killed runs (symex 48.1 s / 59.0 s), plus the cfg(kani) compile repair.
